cell_edits.source: b4 frame check: nextcount p1 2218.53-2291.13 reads 105 NEXT shifts, 15 complete 7-bags with no bad block and no multi-shift (105 = 15x7, so no spawn is missing), first shift at 2218.533 = game start (init TLOSJ, T spawned and held into the empty box at 2218.6). 105 - 1 first hold - 1 last spawn at 2290.467 that never locked (p1 score: last drop points +2 at 2290.37, no change to the KO at 2291.13) = 103. The 9.67 s gap window 2245.13-2254.77 (stream lag) holds one piece: shifts 2245.133 and 2254.767 only, score 2244.33 +1500, 2253.97 +3750 (quad, the held I), 2255.67 +1800 (single), REN bonuses rising 150 per clear, so no unseen non-clearing lock. Chain cseq 'c021 p1' also holds exactly 103 non-BREAK events, all matched to shifts. The table's 107 has no frame support.

no_change.why: c027 p2 179 stands. nextcount's queue reading starts at 2557.367 and misses the first spawn: fr/g4/c027s.png shows the L spawning at 2557.37 with the queue already shifted (L gone from NEXT), so spawns = 179 shifts + 1 = 180, less the first hold into the empty box (Z, 2558.10) = 179, which includes the last Z (spawn 2658.53) that the v0 skeptic showed locking on the KO frame. The recount's 177 excluded both the missed first spawn and that KO-frame lock.

c033 p2 131 stands. nextcount's queue reading starts at 2897.267 and misses two spawns: fr/g4/c033s.png shows the L spawning at 2896.87 (locks, score 35) and the T at 2897.27 (score 71) before the first counted shift at 2897.40; so spawns = 130 + 2 = 132, less the first hold into the empty box (O, 2899.30) = 131. The last T (spawn 2962.93) locks as the TSS at 2963.50 (+3600) before the KO 2963.97; no later spawn. These are the chain's two 'unmatched events'.
